brief:
Trump told US troops that Russia and China are supporting Iran, then minimized the significance of that support during the same remarks, Al Jazeera English reported. The former president praised military personnel for their role in what he characterized as a war on Iran.

Trump said he had recently spoken with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, without providing details of their conversation.
dek: Trump praises US troops for their role in the war on Iran and says he has spoken to Netanyahu in recent days.
title: Trump downplays Russia, China backing for Iran at troop meeting
